build_groove_dataset_builder: build a tfds GeneratorBasedBuilder for the Groove MIDI Dataset with configurable audio and bar-splitting options
create_groove_config: create a GrooveConfig builder config with split_bars, include_audio, and audio_rate parameters
run_split_generators: run _split_generators to download the Groove dataset and parse info.csv into train, validation, and test splits
generate_examples_midi_audio: generate examples from rows yielding id, drummer, bpm, time_signature, style, midi, and optional audio tensors
load_wav_audio: load a WAV file at a given sample rate and return a normalized float32 numpy array
